cal_intro: A calibration is valid for one sweep. An analyzer that keeps the calibration itself loses it when it is switched off: calibrate again after switching on.
cal_sweep_hint: Use the sweep of your measurement. Examples: 1M, 100k, 2.4G.
cal_kit_use: Use a calibration kit with parasitics (ideal standards if not ticked)
cal_step_LOAD: Connect the 50 ohm LOAD to port {port}
cal_step_THRU: Connect a THRU (cable) between port {port} and port {port2}
cal_lost: This instrument keeps the calibration itself: it is lost when it is switched off.
cal_restorable: The calibration data are saved: the calibration can be restored for the same sweep.
cal_retry: Check the connection and press Measure again.
cal_no_vna: The project has no network analyzer.
